# storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy (Data Source)

Fetches the S3 bucket policy for a StorageGrid S3 bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the policy for the logs bucket
data "storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy" "logs" {
  bucket_name = "logs-bucket"
}

output "logs_bucket_policy" {
  value = data.storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy.logs.policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The name of the S3 bucket to fetch the policy for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the bucket policy (same as bucket_name).
- `policy` (String) The bucket policy as a JSON string.
